description: CUR-SEEK, variant: how is a key shorter than the index (or full) compared on IX_ABC (A asc, B desc, C asc)? Ix rows: IDs 1-12 are (A,B,C) with A 1-2, B 1-3, C 1-2 in ascending order, ID 13 is (3,1,1). A new table-type recordset starting at the last index row runs Seek for each of =, >=, >, <=, < with the keys (1), (2), (3), (1,2), (2,1), (1,2,1) and (2,3); after each Seek Errors, NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
